text: 1. A valid foreign passport or nationality certificate (if already in China, a valid visa or residence permit in China is required);2. Notarial certificate of no criminal record;3. Health certificate;4. Financial guarantee;5. Applicants under the age of 18 and whose parents are not permanent residents in China need to provide a formal power of attorney from their parents;6. Notarized certificate of academic degree and transcript;7. If you apply for courses taught in Chinese, you need to provide HSK Level 4 or above;8. Non-english speaking international students who apply for courses taught in English are required to provide a valid proof of English proficiency;9. Applicants for doctoral and master's degrees are required to provide two letters of recommendation from the pre-qualification school (the recommendation date is less than 6 months before the application date) and the research plan;10. Previous graduates are required to provide evidence of relevant experience from the highest degree to the present.Note: The original materials or notarial certificate must be submitted for examination.
